name: jican-simulator
description: 机惨模拟器：服务端权威的单机多智能体校园模拟游戏（原生 SVG + Node.js）

scripts.build:all: node packaging/build.mjs --flavor win10-full --version 1.5rc --stamp 1107 && node packaging/build.mjs --flavor win7-compat --version 1.5rc --stamp 1107
scripts.dist:win10: npm run build:win10 && "C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe" packaging/inno/win10-full.iss
scripts.dist:win7: npm run build:win7 && "C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe" packaging/inno/win7-compat.iss
